title: Very solid, but not effective enough
text: Very solid, but not effective enough. I bought this to replace a super old food mill that I bought at a garage sale forever ago. I love how sturdy it feels, and it’s super easy to put together and take apart, my only (and honestly big) issue is it just doesn’t work nearly as efficiently as my super old one did. For apples it takes way more revolutions (and time) and even when it has done as much as it can do, there is a lot of pulp left.
